description: Review an exact Representation Router PR snapshot by coordinating change scope, contract impact, requirement traceability, verification state, and review state without moving Git/GitHub or source-code semantics into SurfaceSpec.

source_snapshot.review_state: implementation reviewable; canonical npm test execution evidence unavailable

obligations.statement: Add a lifecycle-neutral working-surface contract above ViewSpec without replacing CollectionSpec or importing domain truth.
Read-only and surface-local actions cannot imply external write authority; authoritative writes require an explicit revision-bound authority contract.
Exercise the contract against a real cross-lifecycle software change while keeping domain-specific relationships inside ViewSpecs.
Teach future coding agents when to use ViewSpec, CollectionSpec, and SurfaceSpec and preserve source authority boundaries.
Provide a repository integration path for npm test without claiming it ran when no execution receipt exists.
missing_evidence: executed npm test result for the reviewed subject revision

evidence_semantics.pr_diff: evidence of changed files and content
evidence_semantics.test_definition: implementation of an executable check, not evidence that the check passed
evidence_semantics.ci_configuration: implementation of an execution path, not evidence that a run occurred
evidence_semantics.execution_receipt: required evidence for a claim that the canonical repository suite passed

viewSpecs.concern: What changed in this exact revision, and which kind of contract does each change affect?

interactions.effect: open exact patch at the reviewed subject revision
interactions.purpose: inspect code only after understanding why the file changed

availability.note: The GitHub PR/diff owns change truth; the table only projects it.

rationale: A grouped changed-file ledger gives a reviewer a cheaper first pass than reading the entire diff linearly.
successCriteria: A reviewer can identify the schema, builder, tests, docs, example, and CI areas changed before opening raw patches.

viewSpecs.concern: Which Representation Router architectural contracts are added, preserved, or tightened by this revision?

interactions.effect: show implementing schema/code/docs and related tests
interactions.purpose: review architectural effect rather than file count

rationale: Architecture impact is relational: the new contract sits above ViewSpec while preserving existing ownership and CollectionSpec roles.
successCriteria: A reviewer can explain what SurfaceSpec adds without mistaking it for a semantic store or workflow engine.

viewSpecs.concern: How do the accepted obligations trace to implementation, documentation, and executable test definitions?

interactions.effect: highlight implementation, docs, and test definitions for that obligation
interactions.purpose: make missing coverage visible without equating test presence with test success

missing: executed npm test result for reviewed subject revision
availability.note: Test definitions establish intended checks; they do not establish a passing execution.

rationale: Traceability is the main code-review question, so requirement/change/evidence relationships remain semantic-view data rather than SurfaceSpec fields.
successCriteria: A reviewer can find an obligation without implementation or test-definition coverage and can distinguish definition coverage from executed evidence.

viewSpecs.concern: What verification exists for this exact reviewed revision, and what proof is still missing?

interactions.effect: open exact test, workflow, or execution receipt when present
interactions.purpose: prevent configured checks from masquerading as successful runs

missing: executed npm test result for reviewed subject revision
availability.note: No green repository-suite claim is allowed until an execution receipt exists.

rationale: A verification ledger makes the distinction between configured/defined checks and executed proof explicit.
successCriteria: A reviewer cannot mistake test files or CI YAML for evidence that the repository suite passed.

viewSpecs.concern: Is this exact revision ready for an authoritative code-review disposition?

interactions.effect: store note only in the local review surface
interactions.purpose: support review work without implying a GitHub review was submitted

interactions.effect: show the exact execution evidence required before a green-suite claim
interactions.purpose: keep the remaining review gap actionable

availability.note: Repository access does not itself authorize a GitHub review disposition through SurfaceSpec.

rationale: The code-review surface should summarize what remains before disposition while leaving the actual review authority with GitHub/the repository workflow.
successCriteria: A reviewer can state why the revision is or is not ready without the review surface silently submitting or implying an external disposition.

surfaceOptions.job: Review an exact code change by linking obligations, architecture impact, changed files, test definitions, missing execution evidence, and review state.
surfaceOptions.audience: software maintainer or reviewer, including reviewers who should not need to reconstruct the change from raw code first

sourceBindings.note: GitHub owns pull-request state and review workflow.
Exact subject revision reviewed by this proving-case snapshot.
Outcome, scope, acceptance criteria, verification boundary, and stop conditions for the feature.
Plan for this code-review proving case, including the authority-boundary finding.
Evidence of which files/content changed in the reviewed snapshot.
Executable check definitions; not evidence that they passed.
Configured execution path for npm test; not an execution receipt.

successCriteria: A reviewer can explain what changed and why before opening raw code.
A reviewer can trace each material obligation to implementation, documentation, and test definitions where present.
The surface clearly distinguishes test definitions and CI configuration from actual executed test evidence.
No GitHub review disposition is implied or submitted without an explicit external authority contract.
notes: The reviewed subject is intentionally pinned; later commits to the PR require a fresh review snapshot rather than silent reuse.
Test definitions and CI configuration are implementation artifacts, not evidence of a passing run.
Repository access does not by itself supply reviewer authority for an authoritative-write action.
